targets.name: Willis Tower
targets.text: The Willis (Sears) Tower: 110 stories, 1,451 ft to its roof. Union Station, two stops back, is two blocks west of it.

targets.name: Bally's Chicago
targets.text: Bally's Chicago, the city's casino resort, a short walk east along Chicago Ave.
targets.walk: About a 4-minute walk east along Chicago Ave (300 m)
targets.source: Walk: OpenStreetMap's streets from the top of the station's stairs at 2.75 mph, with the Chicago Ave and Halsted St viaducts rebuilt

targets.name: Halsted Pointe
targets.text: Onni Group's riverfront neighborhood at the south tip of Goose Island: homes in five towers, a hotel, a riverwalk and a beach. The first tower opens in 2028.
targets.walk: About a 5-minute walk north on Halsted St (340 m)
targets.source: Walk: OpenStreetMap's streets from the top of the station's stairs at 2.75 mph, with the Chicago Ave and Halsted St viaducts rebuilt

targets.name: Prairie Material
targets.text: Prairie Material's Yard 32, a ready-mix concrete plant on the North Branch: sand and gravel come up the river by barge, and trucks carry the concrete to job sites. A 2025 job posting for CDL truck drivers listed this yard.
targets.walk: About a 4-minute walk to the gate at the north end of Peoria St (280 m)
targets.source: Prairie Materials (prairie.com); a Votorantim Cimentos job posting, February 2025. Walk: OpenStreetMap's streets from the top of the station's stairs at 2.75 mph, with the Chicago Ave and Halsted St viaducts rebuilt

targets.name: #8 Halsted bus
targets.text: CTA's #8 Halsted: north to Lincoln Park and Lakeview, south through Pilsen and Bridgeport. It stops at the corner of Chicago Ave, a few steps from the station's stairs.
targets.every: Every 6 minutes around 8 AM on weekdays, and all night
targets.source: CTA's weekday schedule (GTFS) for spring 2025, before the Chicago Ave and Halsted St viaducts closed for rebuilding
targets.walk: Under a minute's walk from the station's stairs

targets.name: #66 Chicago bus
targets.text: CTA's #66 Chicago: east to Streeterville and Navy Pier, west to Austin. It stops at the corner of Halsted St.
targets.every: Every 4 to 8 minutes around 8 AM on weekdays, and all night
targets.source: CTA's weekday schedule (GTFS) for spring 2025, before the Chicago Ave and Halsted St viaducts closed for rebuilding
targets.walk: Under a minute's walk from the station's stairs

targets.name: Division/Elston
targets.text: The X1's next stop, at Division St and Elston Ave, about 1.4 km up the line.

targets.name: Clybourn
targets.text: Metra's Clybourn station, the stop after Division/Elston, where the X1 runs on the UP North's tracks. Transfer to Union Pacific Northwest trains.
